name: Google Antigravity
tagline: Google's agent-first IDE, desktop app, CLI, and SDK for running agent teams.
description: Antigravity is Google's agentic development environment, spanning an IDE, a desktop command center for orchestrating agent teams, a terminal CLI, editor extensions, and a Python SDK. Agents can run in parallel across isolated git worktrees and produce plans, diffs, and verification artifacts for review.

pricing.notes: Free plan; higher limits with Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra, and enterprise plans via Google Cloud.
